title: A uniform relative deviation inequality for VC-subgraph classes
summary: We establish a new Bernstein-type deviation inequality for classes of functions whose complexity is characterized through subgraphs. The inequality is non-asymptotic, involves explicit constants, and features a relative normalization by the probability level. Applied to kernel density estimation, it produces a location and bandwidth-adaptive error bound between the estimator and the smoothed density, holding simultaneously over all points on the real line and all positive bandwidths.
